component.name: AudioStatusTask
component.script:
sub init() m.top.functionName = "loadAudioStatus" end sub
sub loadAudioStatus() m.top.statusText = "Volume: unavailable" deviceInfo = createObject("roDeviceInfo") addresses = deviceInfo.getIPAddrs() if type(addresses) <> "roAssociativeArray" then return
deviceIp = "" for each interfaceName in addresses candidate = addresses[interfaceName] if candidate <> invalid and candidate.toStr() <> "" deviceIp = candidate.toStr() exit for end if end for if deviceIp = "" then return
transfer = createObject("roUrlTransfer") transfer.setUrl("http://" + deviceIp + ":8060/query/audio-device") port = createObject("roMessagePort") transfer.setMessagePort(port) if not transfer.asyncGetToString() then return
event = wait(2000, port) if event = invalid or type(event) <> "roUrlEvent" transfer.asyncCancel() return end if if event.getResponseCode() < 200 or event.getResponseCode() >= 300 then return
body = event.getString() volume = elementText(body, "volume") muted = LCase(elementText(body, "muted")) if muted = "true" m.top.statusText = "Volume: muted" else if volume <> "" m.top.statusText = "Volume: " + volume + "%" end if end sub
function elementText(text as string, name as string) as string openTag = "<" + name + ">" closeTag = "</" + name + ">" startAt = instr(1, text, openTag) if startAt = 0 then return "" valueStart = startAt + len(openTag) endAt = instr(valueStart, text, closeTag) if endAt = 0 then return "" return text.mid(valueStart - 1, endAt - valueStart) end function
